name: geotrek-mcp
description: MCP server for searching treks (hiking, mountain biking, horse riding, snowshoeing, etc.) on a GeoTrek instance via its public API, with geocoding via Nominatim. Exposes tools to search treks by duration, elevation, regulation labels, activity type, and proximity to a place or coordinates.
